releaseNotes: v1.3.0 -- Discovery now runs automatically on first open (no more manual 'Run discovery now' click). Added a read-only supportedFeatures attribute (PTZ, Spotlight, Siren, Person/Vehicle/Pet Detection, etc.), populated from Reolink's GetAbility API and refreshable via a new Check Abilities command -- informational only, does not hide any commands. Clarified that local API access is unavailable for all battery-powered devices (including the Gen 2 doorbell) regardless of power source. Trimmed in-file changelog history. Also includes v1.2.5 (fixed excessive hub load from unconditional sendEvent() calls; replaced debug logging with Errors Only / Normal / Full log levels), v1.2.3 (snapshot tile fixes, self-healing scheduler, per-device poll/snapshot intervals), v1.2.2 (fixed snapshot tiles breaking on token expiry), v1.2.1 (diagnostic logging fix), and v1.2.0 (PTZ calibration support).
author: jdthomas24
